topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
response: LEO satellites have smaller aperture sizes due to lower orbit altitudes, allowing for higher gain and portability in CMOS-based ground terminals. GEO satellites require larger apertures for comparable gain, impacting portability.
reference_context: SatCom systems involve LEO and GEO satellites with different orbits, affecting antenna gain and size, thus influencing ground terminal design for optimal performance.
